brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: 2-storey 2x2 cell enclosure (pieces 0,0,0/1,0/1,1,0/0,1 over 0,0,1 etc) with open bottom, capped side faces, interior void usable for storage
4x top covers at level 1 (cover:0,0,1; cover:0,1,1; cover:1,0,1; cover:1,1,1) forming solid deck that closes the box

Covers include magnets by default; setCoverMagnets check returned ALREADY_FITTED/NO_CHANGE - a cover has them unless taken out, so all 4 lid covers are magnetic and attract to steel interfaces to hold shut

finish.summary: Built 2-high 2x2 hex storage box with solid top deck of 4 full covers. All covers ship with integrated magnets, verified by configurator (already fitted), so lid is magnetically retained shut. Side faces capped and joints locked.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
